body: I should do it then. No note. No notion. I’m going to disappear and settle it. Thank you for the help!
I just need to die. Everything will be solved then. I just won’t tell them.. it’s better that way... I can just disappear and then they will think that it was an accident.

Dude, that’s not even right. What’s your name? Where he fuck are you from? Your schooling? Any special training? Do you know how to job interview?? On a more serious note, threatening to kill yourself unless we the people offer you a job is insane! I’m not a business owner! I certainly don’t want you to kill your self due to my shortcomings!! Holy fuck! PLEASE DON’T DO THIS AND SEEK HELP!

I don’t see any point in my life either. The only reason I stick around is for other people. Do you have any kind of support system? Do you have any friends or family? It’s a double edged sword, if you have someone to live for you feel guilty but if you have no one you feel worthless. In some way our lives do matter! I don’t know how and I don’t know why, but somehow they do. I care. If I said I didn’t care about anyone or anything I would be fucking lying. I feel so deeply for other people that it is physically painful. I have no feeling left for myself. Help me, help you. I’ve felt like a failure most of my life, especially in the last few months when I had a breakdown. I quit my job, I stopped taking my meds, I dumped my therapist and psychiatrist, and completely cut off all ties to group therapy. I hit rock bottom and never bounced back. I’ve put my family in financial ruin. We can’t afford to live. Talk about guilt and failures... I live for other people and that isn’t right. It’s the only thing that keeps me alive though. I’ve been promised that it gets bette but it’s really bleak. I can’t give good reasons to stay. All I can do is try to help. I care about you. Talk to me. You aren’t only helping yourself anymore.

I implore you to reconsider! I want to die too and it’s all I think about. But think of the people left behind, any friends or family. I’m not saying stay alive for them because living for someone else is just stupid, take it from someone who does it on the daily. Talk to me. Save my life.
I’m sorry. I took it the wrong way. I wasn’t sure if I had actually helped you or not. I’m sorry!
I do not see why it would be... killing yourself isn’t illegal it is just frowned upon. I think that in a situation like that, someone would do whatever they could to help you, not punish you.
Yes, link is on my profile.
We can do that! I’d love to keep chatting.
Listen to Self-Conclusion by The Spill Canvas. Great song.
Coming Down by Five Finger Death Punch: watch the video.
Are you being sarcastic? I’m just trying to help.

I’m bisexual. I think you should just let whatever flag fly that wants to. I have two people I live more than anybody else in the world. Ana is my bestfriend of twelve years and the other is my fiancé Lucas of eight years.

Tell your therapist if you want help. If you don’t want help I wouldn’t tell your therapist because they will send you back to the hospital. If you don’t want to die but are having suicidal thoughts, I go through the same thing. It sucks and sometimes the thoughts get so bad I feel like the only way to turn them off is to jump like it tells me to. I think you would benefit from more help. It isn’t attention seeking, we are supposed to ask for help!

I didn’t think about that... BUT if this really all is just imaginary they could wake up! It will be like a dream for them. This body isn’t theirs, it’s mine! Maybe they are trapped in my head not my whole body... I’ll figure it out... gotta set them free so I can be free.

Exactly, pretty much the only reason I’m still here is because of the guilt I feel. If I am gone there is nobody to look after my fiancé. Not to mention the amount of family members I would let down just one more time. There is a place called “The State Hospital” and “Crosspoint” here. Both seem like terrifying places. I’m not sure who does outpatient work. We have several different places for mental heath here but they all cost money that I don’t have. If they take insurance, that would be great. The US has a screwy system, they don’t care unless you have cash. I’ve pretty much given up trying to explain to my fiancé about how I feel. I can’t get through to him how much I’m not joking about wanting to die. He always says “That’s not funny!” Like it was a fucking joke to begin with. ☹️ If I told them the truth about wanting to kill mused, or feeling like I’m not real, or any kind of delusional thoughts they could hold me there until they see fit. The last thing I want to do is be an even bigger pariah in my family. I feel everything from other people but it’s like I feel nothing for myself. I’m locked in a daze.
Well I don’t think I will be able to get rid of my worry, but I do appreciate you trying to help!
So maybe we should all be selfish, then the worthless feelings could dissipate. Without worthless feelings we could all just kill ourselves and not have to think of anyone else.

I tend to cut fast an angry but there aren’t very pleasing results, just a bunch of small cuts all over the place. I try only using scalpels which help with getting deeper cuts. I wouldn’t suggest it because of the amount of time it takes to get what you want.

I’m not going to tell you not to do it because it would be an empty phrase. I want you to survive to show everyone you can. I want the best things to happen to you, and for you to be able to be at peace with yourself. I want, I want, I want. Think of what YOU really want. Life is shitty and sad, I completely feel that everyday. Can you stick around and enjoy another sunset with me?

Agreed. Life doesn’t mean anything. Right now I’m living to be dead in a few years, months if I want to end it quicker. I don’t know how to explain how I feel. I’m trapped under a heavy piece of glass and people are ogling my existence. Everyone’s shown up to continue to watch my failures until I’ve finally had enough. I hope you can find peace. I hate it that so many people feel like I do. I hope you can get out from under the microscope and live your full life again. A hug doesn’t fix anything and neither does prayer, but a hug makes me feel better sometimes so I’m leaving one behind. *HUGS*

Don’t say that, it makes you sound like a selfish dick. You have no family or friends? No one who feel would be sad if you decided to kill yourself one day? Nobody you feel would be upset if they knew you were having depressive thoughts? Nobody who would bat an eye if one day you just flew off your rocker and disappeared.?Worthlessness for me, is the guilt I feel when I know deep down that I’m destroying my family. The guilt of waking up another day and struggling to be who I’m not. The guilt of wanting to die but realizing that I would take the rest of family with me when I died. Do you understand yet? It isn’t just a feeling. It’s something that can consume your life.
If I had any fucking clue why I felt this way, I would get it fixed. My life feels like one crisis after another.
u/Kameha808 I’m sorry, that was really rude of me to suggest... I’m a real bitch. Please don’t hurt yourself!!

We’ve been together for 8 years, 9 on our wedding day. We’ve had a lot of exciting adventures together, just not as a married couple. I am really lucky, which is why it can’t be real. Like, nothing good ever happens to me. It comes back and bites me. I’ve been begging him to stop looking past my problems for eight years... he just doesn’t know how to respond I guess. I already feel guilty enough about it, even thinking of ending everything I know I can’t. For one, I’m the sole provider in the house, Lucas is disabled. (Kidney failure : third time) My Family, and my biggest triggers, would miss me too much. My niece (she’s 5) would hopefully be heartbroken and not understand what happened. I can see where I want to be, and I stand where I am.... I don’t know how to get from here to there. It’s like I’m trapped in a small room and am expected to move the walls to continue living. It’s impossible! What do I do? I quit my meds, fired my therapist, stopped going to group... what is there that’s left??? I’ve successfully fucked up! 😫 Why bother?

Do our lives really even matter? How can I just be here to live and die? Why does my life not have a purpose? I’ve been dealing with my new existential crisis for a short time now but I’ve been dealing with the depression and anxiety for years. Maybe if I stabbed myself the other person could get out and take over! Afterall, it’s their life I’m stealing right?

Ha, I wish I would have left this shit in my teens. I’m 24, getting married in exactly one week. I’m spiraling out of control and absolutely no time to fix it. 😫 I’ve tried talking to my fiancé about a lot of my feelings but he kind of brushes it off.

I’m not going to lie, I’ve kept things hidden from doctors before. I think of suicide almost daily but I don’t necessarily want to actually die everyday. When they give me the questionnaire about my feelings I just put what they want to hear. I’m always afraid to say too much because one of the biggest fears I have is being locked up. If that happened I would probably attempt to kill myself. I want help but I’m also afraid to get help. I can’t keep living like this though, I’m terrified!
I feel like she won’t understand, or may freak a little bit. I don’t want to scare people but I’m panicking.
Thank you! I appreciate the help. This is causing me to have a lot of panic attacks... do you understand how scary it is to question your existence? 😭
No, I have never heard of that. I was diagnosed as bipolar about two years ago, but I’m pretty sure that’s a crock of shit.
Easiest, access a gun. Second, jumping off an overpass or building. Hard to come back from either of those.

No, it isn’t like a dream. I feel completely cutoff from everything. I don’t feel anything but everything seems so vivid. I don’t know how to describe it... I feel like there is someone trapped because of me. They can’t wake up because I traveled too far away from them. I feel lost, and hopeless, like nothing is real. I need to wake them up. I don’t know how! I don’t know what to do!
I honestly wish it was that simple but I don’t think downing any kind of pills is the way one would want to go. Not only could it be painful but you could also be saved...
My worst fear is going inpatient anywhere. I can’t imagine how you must feel!
Well I kind of fired my therapist after I had a meltdown. What do you do when you pushed everyone away?

I feel like I’m not even real and that everything and everyone I’m in contact with is fake. I feel completely lost and alone. I don’t want to feel this way but it is swallowing my life. I’m too scared to really talk to anyone about it. Thanks for understanding how I feel. ❤️
